name: sources
description: Rate-source parsers (the ECB's XML, CSV and SDMX-CSV, the Bank of Canada's Valet JSON, the Fed's H.10 CSV, the Bank of England's CSV, HMRC's monthly CSV) on the fixtures in spec/fixtures/ and malformed variants; quoted rates; lookups over dated tables with their fallbacks; and the rates on Stripe balance transactions and Adyen settlement rows.

provenance.method: The fixtures in spec/fixtures/ (and small inline variants) read with Python's standard library, independently of ducat's parsers, by the rules in docs/reference/rate-sources.md; publication times from the sources' stated local times and clock rules written out in the generator.
